title: Your slow-season game plan: 3 automations to install now

slides.headline: Calls are down 30–40% right now. Good.
slides.body: That's your setup window. 3 automations to install before the January heat calls and the June wave.

slides.headline: 1. Missed-call text-back
slides.body:
Rings out → customer gets a text in 10 seconds: "Emergency, or call you right back?" Keeps them off Google.
Cost: usually <$100/mo · Setup: ~15 min (check your current phone system first — it may be built in)
Why now: test it on low volume, mistakes are cheap in November.

slides.headline: 2. Estimate follow-up sequence
slides.body:
Every open quote gets a text on day 1, 3, 7, and 14 — automatically. Most shops follow up once or never; followed-up quotes close at roughly DOUBLE the rate.
Cost: $50–$300/mo depending on your software · Setup: an afternoon
Why now: your 90-day dead-quote pile is sitting right there to test on.

slides.headline: 3. Review request on job close
slides.body:
Tech closes the ticket → customer gets a review link automatically. No more "forgetting to ask." 91% of homeowners check reviews; 56% start on Google.
Cost: often free inside your field software · Setup: ~30 min
Why now: every winter job banks reviews for summer's Map Pack fight.

slides.headline: The order matters.
slides.body: Text-back first (fastest win). Reviews second (compounds daily). Follow-up third (biggest dollars, most setup). All three together: typically under $400/mo — less than one recovered service call.

slides.headline: What NOT to do in November.
slides.body: Don't buy a $1,000/mo "all-in-one AI platform" because a rep called during your slow season. Install the three basics, run them 60 days, look at the numbers in January. Then decide.
